explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/910: for n ≥ 2, must every connected set in ℝⁿ have more than 2^ℵ₀ connected subsets? Read literally this is trivially false (a segment has only 𝔠 connected subsets). The statement follows [Er82e] in requiring dimension > 1 (small inductive dimension) and asserts more than 𝔠 nontrivial connected subsets. This is a well-justified reading of the intended question, documented with sources. Faithful.
